sourcedFrom: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) (undated on cover)
cleanIntro: Springfield's own field strip for the Model 2020 Rimfire, and it is a short one: safety on, bolt back, press the bolt stop and the bolt slides out the rear. That is the entire strip. ⛔ The bolt itself does NOT come apart — Springfield says so directly — and the deep clean is the barrelled action out of the stock, which is a torque job, not a disassembly.

steps.title: Eye protection, muzzle safe, finger off
steps.action: Eye protection on, muzzle in a safe direction, finger off the trigger, and no live ammunition anywhere near the bench.
steps.prose: Springfield opens the field strip with the ammunition caution rather than closing with it.
steps.quote: Always use proper eye protection when cleaning firearms.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — FIELD STRIP, printed p.30, step 1
steps.warn: CAUTION: Never allow live ammunition in the area while you are maintaining your firearms.

steps.title: Safety to S, magazine out, rifle unloaded
steps.action: Put the safety in the 'S' position, remove the magazine and unload the rifle. The rifle will fire with or without a magazine in place.
steps.prose: Safety first here, before the magazine — the order in the book is deliberate on a bolt gun, because the bolt is about to move.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — FIELD STRIP, printed p.30, steps 3-4
steps.warn: ALWAYS REMEMBER THE FIREARM IS ABLE TO FIRE WITH OR WITHOUT THE MAGAZINE IN PLACE.

steps.title: Bolt fully back, and look
steps.action: Retract the bolt to its most rearward position and look into the chamber and the magazine well.
steps.prose: A .22 LR case is small and brass-on-brass in a dark receiver. Get light in there rather than trusting a glance.
steps.aside: To properly clear a firearm, remove the magazine, then pull charging handle back and check the chamber.
steps.quote: Retract the bolt to its most rearward position.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — FIELD STRIP, printed p.30, step 5

steps.title: Press the bolt stop, bolt out the back
steps.action: Depress the REAR SURFACE of the bolt stop and draw the bolt rearward out of the receiver.
steps.prose: It is the rear face of the stop specifically — pressing anywhere else on it does nothing, and the bolt simply will not come.
steps.quote: Depress the rear surface of the bolt stop
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — FIELD STRIP, printed p.30, step 6

steps.title: Field strip complete — the bolt stays whole
steps.action: The rifle is stripped for routine cleaning: barrelled action in the stock, and the bolt in your hand. ⛔ Do not take the bolt apart.
steps.prose: Springfield states that bolt disassembly is neither required nor recommended for routine cleaning, and there is no published procedure for it in this book.
steps.quote: The rifle is now field stripped for routine cleaning.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — FIELD STRIP, printed p.30, step 6
steps.warn: NOTE: Disassembly of the bolt is not required or recommended for routine cleaning.

deepSteps.title: Bore from the chamber, ejection port DOWN
deepSteps.action: With the bolt out, lay the rifle horizontally with the ejection port facing DOWNWARD, and clean the barrel from the CHAMBER to the muzzle.
deepSteps.prose: Port down is what keeps solvent and fouling falling out of the action instead of into the trigger group — a rimfire's fouling is waxy and it stays wherever it lands.
deepSteps.quote: Barrel should lay horizontally with the ejection port facing downward during cleaning. Always clean the barrel from the chamber to the muzzle.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE BARREL, printed p.33

deepSteps.title: ⛔ Never reverse a brush inside the bore
deepSteps.action: Push the brush completely out of the muzzle before retracting it. Never change direction while the brush is still in the bore.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ A bristle brush reversed mid-bore jams: the bristles fold the wrong way and lock. Getting one out afterwards usually means a rod and a vice, and sometimes a gunsmith.
deepSteps.quote: You cannot change direction of the brush when brush is in the bore as this can jam the brush in the bore.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE BARREL, printed p.33

deepSteps.title: Patches until clean, then oil, then dry
deepSteps.action: Jag and patch saturated with solvent through the bore, a NEW patch each time, until the patches show no fouling. Then one clean patch with gun oil, and one clean dry patch to take the excess back out.
deepSteps.prose: Oiled then dried, not oiled and left — a wet rimfire bore collects unburnt lubricant off the bullets and the fouling builds faster.
deepSteps.quote: Repeat using a new patch each time, until the patch no longer shows fouling present.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE BARREL, printed p.33

deepSteps.title: ⛔ Action out of the stock — two screws
deepSteps.action: With the bolt out and the safety on 'S', remove the two action screws fore and aft of the magazine well and lift the barrelled action out of the stock.
deepSteps.prose: This is the only reason to take a Model 2020 Rimfire further apart, and it exists so the inside of the receiver can be flushed.
deepSteps.quote: Remove the two action screws located fore and aft of the magazine well and lift the action from the stock
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE RECEIVER, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: Flush the receiver and let it dry
deepSteps.action: Spray the inside of the receiver thoroughly with a suitable aerosol action cleaner and let it dry completely before anything goes back together.
deepSteps.prose: Aerosol action cleaner evaporates dry and leaves nothing behind, which is the point — it is not a lubricant and must not be treated as one.
deepSteps.quote: Thoroughly spray inside the receiver with a suitable aerosol action cleaner such as Gun Scrubber and allow to dry.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE RECEIVER, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: ⛔ Torque the action screws — 35 in-lbs, front first
deepSteps.action: Refit the action and screws, tightening the two screws fore and aft of the magwell FIRST, and do not exceed 35 in-lbs.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ This is the number that decides whether the rifle shoots where it did before. Over-torqued action screws bend the receiver and move the zero; under-torqued ones let it wander shot to shot.
deepSteps.quote: Tighten the two actions fore and aft of the magwell first, do not exceed 35in lbs.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — CLEANING THE RECEIVER, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: Lubricate the bolt body and lugs — no grease
deepSteps.action: Light lubricant on the bolt body, in the bolt way of the receiver, and on the rear faces of the bolt locking lugs.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ Grease is specifically excluded from the bore of the bolt body and from the firing pin and its spring — a greased rimfire firing pin gets slow in the cold and starts producing light strikes.
deepSteps.quote: Do not use grease in the bore of the bolt body or on the firing pin or spring.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Model 2020 Rimfire Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part or revision code printed) — LUBRICATION POINTS, printed p.36

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Correct-calibre brush and solvent, chamber to muzzle, ejection port DOWN
New patch each pass until they come out clean
One oiled patch, then one dry patch to remove the excess

cleaning.name: RECEIVER & BOLT
tasks: Wipe the bolt way and the bolt body; do not take the bolt apart
Light oil on the bolt body and the rear faces of the locking lugs
⛔ No grease in the bolt body bore, on the firing pin or on its spring

cleaning.name: STOCK & MAGAZINE
tasks: Thin coat of oil on the outside of the barrel and action with a soft cloth
Wipe the magazine body and follower dry
Check the action screws are still at torque after a hard session

reassembly: Reassembly is the disassembly steps in reverse: slide the bolt into the receiver past the bolt stop and close it.
If the action came out of the stock, refit it and torque the two screws fore and aft of the magwell first, not exceeding 35 in-lbs.
Safety to 'S', then function check before the rifle goes away.
fncheck: Magazine out and chamber confirmed empty, cycle the bolt several times, check the safety holds in 'S', and confirm the bolt stop retains the bolt.
